raw_segments.text: At that time, as always happens, the highest society that met at court and at the grand
balls was divided into several circles, each with its own particular tone. The largest of
these was the French circle of the Napoleonic alliance, the circle of Count Rumyántsev and
Caulaincourt. In this group Hélène, as soon as she had settled in Petersburg with her
husband, took a very prominent place. She was visited by the members of the French embassy
and by many belonging to that circle and noted for their intellect and polished manners.
